title: Similar: Saturn Aurora Consensus Frontier
goal: Sweep consensus-building hyperparameters for citizen-science Saturn aurora markings, average agreement score and localization error against expert annotations across images, filter out weak configurations, and write the non-dominated trade-off set to `/root/aurora_frontier.csv`.
skillBenefitRationale: 核心难点是从一批双目标候选配置中找出非支配解，并正确处理一个目标最大化、一个目标最小化以及阈值过滤；其余只是按题面规则汇总指标。
